title: Local Anesthesia:
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Temporary loss of sensation in a small area of the body to lessen pain and discomfort during medical, surgical and dental procedures while the patient remains awake.

runs.text: Temporary loss of sensation in a small area of the body to lessen pain and discomfort during medical, surgical and dental
procedures while the patient remains awake.

blocks.text: This can be in the form of topical application of Local Anesthetics (Cream- EMLA, Spray) or intramuscular infiltration.
